This row is the feedgas pipeline for the Train 4 expansion (Capacity 740 MMcf/d, StartYear1 2028, 42-inch/17.06 km per the wiki lead, matching FERC's Train 4 docket CP17-470 in every particular I could check -- capacity, in-service target, and county). Owner is already 'Freeport LNG Development LP [100.%]' on the sheet; Operator was blank. Source 1 (FERC, gov/primary origin): the Commission's environmental assessment for Docket CP17-470 names the joint applicants as 'Freeport LNG Development, L.P.' and 'FLNG Liquefaction 4, LLC' for the pipeline, liquefaction and export facilities of the Train 4 Project -- FLNG Liquefaction 4, LLC is the single-train liquefaction-facility entity, while Freeport LNG Development, L.P. is named as applicant for the pipeline/terminal facilities specifically. Source 2 (freeportlng.com, the company's own Train 4 Expansion page, independent of the FERC filing): describes Train 4 as an expansion of 'Freeport LNG Development's existing Quintana Island Terminal,' confirming Freeport LNG Development, L.P. as the operating entity for the terminal and its associated pipeline infrastructure. Staged using the full legal form ('Freeport LNG Development, L.P.') as it appears in the FERC docket, matching the sheet's existing Owner string with the comma/period legal-suffix formatting FERC uses.
